name: Period type code
description: Code specifying the type of period.

values.name: Quarter
values.description: Quarter A subdivision of a year into four equal parts.

values.name: Half-year
values.description: Half-year A subdivision of a year into two equal parts.

values.name: Air hour
values.description: Air hour Flight duration irrespective of time zones.

values.name: Air day
values.description: Air day Flight duration irrespective of time zones.

values.name: Calendar day (includes weekends and holidays)
values.description: Calendar day (includes weekends and holidays) Period given as a number of days including weekends and holidays.

values.name: Calendar week (7day)
values.description: Calendar week (7day) Period given as a number of 7day-weeks including holidays.

values.name: Day
values.description: Day The twenty-four hour period during which the earth completes one rotation on its axis.

values.name: Ten days period
values.description: Ten days period Period of 10 days.

values.name: Period of two weeks
values.description: Period of two weeks A period of time lasting fourteen days. Synonym: Fortnight.

values.name: Hour
values.description: Hour One of the twenty-four sub-divisions of a day.

values.name: Half month
values.description: Half month A subdivision of a month into two equal parts.

values.name: Month
values.description: Month One of twelve divisions of the year as determined by the Gregorian calendar.

values.name: Minute
values.description: Minute A unit of time equal to 1/60 of an hour, or 60 seconds.

values.name: Four month period
values.description: Four month period A period of time, measured in monthly increments, consisting of four sequential months.

values.name: Second
values.description: Second A unit of time equal to 1/60 of a minute.

values.name: Surface day
values.description: Surface day The voyage duration irrespective of time zones.

values.name: Indefinite
values.description: Indefinite An indefinite period.

values.name: Week
values.description: Week Period of seven days.

values.name: Workday
values.description: Workday Day on which work is usually done.

values.name: 5 day work week
values.description: 5 day work week Monday through Friday.

values.name: Year
values.description: Year The period of time as measured by the Gregorian calendar in which the earth completes a single revolution around the sun.

values.name: Mutually defined
values.description: Mutually defined Period as per agreement.
